entities.summary: Soviet, a notable figure in the history of Finland, associated with Winter War & Continuation War (1939–1940). Preceded by Moscow Peace Treaty and Finland repels Soviet forces at the Battle of Suomussalmi during the Winter War. Their legacy influenced Continuation War & Lapland War and 1947 Paris Peace Treaty.
